text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Former president Kenneth Kaunda's special advisor, Arnold Chooka, has advised him to resign as leader of the United National Independence Party (UNIP) to save it from collapse.
- Close to 100 refugees fleeing ethnic violence in Zaire have crossed the border into Zambia, the government commissioner for refugees said.

- Environment Minister William Harrington says the government will push through new laws to control imports of plastic products, which contribute to environmental degradation because they are not biodegradable.
- Cholera has broken out in the northern mining town of Ndola, afflicting 12 people so far, health officials said.
